name: Equilateral Enterprises Limited
about: Equilateral Enterprises Limited primarily engages in the trading of gems and jewelry, and diamonds in India. It also trades in ornaments that contains diamonds, gold, silver, and other precious or semi-precious stones. The company was formerly known as Surya Industrial Corporation Limited and changed its name to Equilateral Enterprises Limited in March 2020. Equilateral Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Surat, India.
